Hi Marissa,

Hope you’re well — I’m Liam, head of partnerships at Maestro. We build a prompts-first SDK used by data teams and ISVs for prompt orchestration (LangChain + LlamaIndex integrations already in-market). We’re exploring a partner playground to validate two things quickly: (1) end-to-end tracing across Maestro <> Redwood (trace propagation, token attribution), and (2) prompt tooling/runtime ergonomics when running through Redwood’s hosted and dedicated tiers.

Our ask: a 4–6 week technical playground where we wire a small set of Maestro customer scenarios through Redwood, exercise the LangChain and LlamaIndex SDK paths, and validate trace hooks + prompt instrumentation. We prepared a short tech spec (attached) showing the SDK hooks, connector points, and expected telemetry.

Can we schedule a 45m sync next week? Priya (cc’d) will be the engineering lead on our side. High-level availability: Tue/Wed mornings PT.

Attachments: maestro_tech_spec_v1.pdf (2 pages)

Thanks — excited to explore.

— Liam

I’ve attached a short draft SOW we usually start with and a checklist for telemetry requirements. Can you confirm Priya + one engineer for the playground? We can do Tue 09/15 10:00–10:45 PT or Wed 09/16 09:00–09:45 PT — which works better?
